name: Meprobamate
summary: Meprobamate, sold under the brand names Miltown and Equanil, among others, is a carbamate derivative used as an anxiolytic drug. It was the best-selling minor tranquilizer for a time, but has largely been replaced by the benzodiazepines due to their wider therapeutic index and lower incidence of serious side effects.

pharmacology.text: Although it was marketed as being safer, meprobamate has most of the pharmacological effects and dangers of barbiturates and acts at the barbiturate binding site (though it is less sedating at effective doses). It is reported to have some anticonvulsant properties against absence seizures, but can exacerbate generalized tonic–clonic seizures.

uses.text: Meprobamate is indicated for the short-term relief of anxiety, although whether the purported anxiolytic effects of meprobamate are separable from its sedative effects is not known. Its effectiveness as a selective agent for the treatment of anxiety has not been proven in humans, and is not used as often as the benzodiazepines for this purpose.

sideEffects.text: It was the best-selling minor tranquilizer for a time, but has largely been replaced by the benzodiazepines due to their wider therapeutic index (lower risk of toxicity at therapeutically prescribed doses) and lower incidence of serious side effects.

zhOther: 眠爾通, 甲丙巴酸酯, 甲丙氨脂
summaryZh: 甲丙氨酯（英語：Meprobamate）是一種氨基甲酸酯衍生物，是一種抗焦慮藥物。它曾一度是最暢銷的輕度鎮靜劑，但由於苯二氮䓬類藥物有較廣的治療指數（在治療劑量下，產生的毒性風險較低）及嚴重副作用的發生率較少，目前大多已被其取代。

fact.en: Sold as Miltown from 1955, meprobamate became the first blockbuster psychiatric drug in the United States. It was named after Milltown, a small town in New Jersey near where it was made.
fact.zh: 甲丙氨酯從1955年起以「眠爾通」（Miltown）販售，成為美國第一個暢銷的精神科藥物。它的名稱來自研製地附近的紐澤西州小鎮 Milltown。
fact.zhHans: 甲丙氨酯从1955年起以「眠尔通」（Miltown）贩售，成为美国第一个畅销的精神科药物。它的名称来自研制地附近的纽泽西州小镇 Milltown。
